game.name: Fish Hook
ui.tip_menu: Click the bucket / bait box / rod to prepare, then click the water to cast
ui.tip_bite: Fish on! Hold left button and pull down!
ui.tip_fight: Pull down to reel! Keep the pull between the red lines!
ui.bite_miss: The fish spat the hook and left...
dev.tip_bite_now: Instant bite: triggers a bite on the next frame while waiting
dev.tip_land_now: Instant land: pulls the fish to shore into the catch show
dev.tip_kind_force: Force bite kind: click to cycle (off → minnow → ... → golden dragon → old boot)
dev.tip_score: Adds 100 score and commits to the leaderboard
dev.tip_bite_avg: Sets bite rate to about one bite per 5 s (mult 5.0)
dev.tip_bite_rate: Global bite-rate multiplier (base rate x bait x chum)
dev.tip_fish_str: Global fish-strength multiplier (base and burst both scaled)
